title: Technical Program Manager
description:
Position: Technical Program Manager

Location: Remote

Role Overview: We are looking for an experienced Technical Program Manager to drive the planning, coordination and successful delivery of complex technology programs across our AI-powered SaaS platforms in the RegTech, ESG, Sustainability, Compliance and Financial Reporting domains.

The role requires a strong technical background combined with excellent program management, execution, stakeholder management and problem-solving skills. You will work closely with Engineering, DevOps and Business teams to translate product strategy into executable technical programs, manage dependencies, track milestones, mitigate risks and ensure predictable, high-quality delivery.

You will serve as a bridge between business objectives and engineering execution, ensuring alignment across teams, visibility into program progress and timely resolution of technical and operational challenges. A solid understanding of modern software architecture, cloud infrastructure, APIs and AI/LLM-based applications is essential to effectively manage technically complex initiatives.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Technical Program Management & Delivery

Own end-to-end planning, coordination, execution and delivery of multiple technical programs and cross-functional initiatives.
Translate business requirements and product roadmaps into program plans, milestones, deliverables, timelines and measurable outcomes.
Coordinate with Engineering, DevOps and other stakeholders to ensure alignment on scope, priorities, dependencies and delivery commitments.
Establish program governance, execution tracking, reporting mechanisms and regular review cadences.
Monitor program progress against timelines, budgets, scope, quality standards and business objectives.
Identify delivery bottlenecks, proactively resolve blockers and drive decisions to keep programs on track.
Manage scope changes, competing priorities, resource constraints and cross-team dependencies.
Drive Agile/Scrum execution, sprint coordination, release planning and continuous improvement in delivery processes.
2. Technical Leadership & Architecture Coordination

Work closely with engineering leaders and architects to understand solution designs, technical dependencies, implementation approaches and delivery risks.
Facilitate technical discussions, architecture reviews, design decisions and cross-team alignment.
Evaluate technical trade-offs involving scalability, performance, security, maintainability, integration complexity and time to market.
Ensure technical decisions align with product objectives, architectural standards and long-term platform strategy.
Coordinate initiatives involving microservices, APIs, multi-tenant SaaS platforms, cloud infrastructure, data processing and enterprise integrations.
Identify technical risks early and drive mitigation plans in collaboration with engineering teams.
Provide technical guidance and challenge assumptions where required without becoming the primary owner of day-to-day coding or people management.
3. AI, Automation & Innovation Programs

Drive the planning and delivery of AI-powered product initiatives involving LLMs, generative AI, NLP and intelligent workflow automation.
Coordinate implementation of AI capabilities such as Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), document intelligence, structured output generation, data extraction and automated validation.
Work with engineering and product teams to define technical milestones, acceptance criteria, dependencies and success metrics for AI initiatives.
Ensure AI implementations address accuracy, reliability, performance, data privacy, security, explainability and operational requirements.
Track model and provider integrations, evaluation activities, deployment readiness and production adoption.
Facilitate the evaluation and adoption of emerging technologies that improve product capabilities, engineering efficiency and business outcomes.
4. Stakeholder Management & Communication

Act as the primary coordination point between technical teams, product leadership, business stakeholders and senior management for assigned programs.
Communicate program status, risks, dependencies, resource requirements and delivery forecasts through clear and actionable reporting.
Set expectations with stakeholders regarding timelines, scope, technical constraints and trade-offs.
Facilitate program reviews, steering meetings, retrospectives and escalation discussions.
Ensure business requirements are translated into clear technical deliverables and that engineering outcomes meet stakeholder expectations.
Drive alignment across distributed teams and ensure accountability for commitments and decisions.
5. Risk, Quality & Release Management

Maintain program-level risk, assumption, issue and dependency tracking, with clear ownership and mitigation plans.
Establish appropriate quality gates, acceptance criteria, testing milestones and release-readiness processes.
Coordinate integration testing, user acceptance testing, performance testing, security assessments and production releases.
Track critical defects, technical debt, operational concerns and unresolved issues that may affect delivery or product reliability.
Ensure delivery processes support security, compliance, auditability and enterprise customer requirements.
Conduct post-release reviews and drive corrective actions and continuous improvement initiatives. 
 6. Process Improvement & Program Metrics

Define and track meaningful delivery metrics, including milestone adherence, predictability, lead time, defect trends, dependency resolution and release quality.
Improve planning, estimation, prioritization, resource coordination and cross-team execution practices.
Standardize program documentation, decision logs, status reporting and escalation processes.
Identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity, delivery efficiency and collaboration.
Promote a culture of ownership, transparency, accountability and continuous improvement.
Required Skills & Experience

10+ years of overall experience in software development, technical delivery, engineering or technology program management.
5+ years of experience managing complex technical projects or programs involving multiple teams and stakeholders.
Strong understanding of software development lifecycle, Agile/Scrum methodologies, release management and program governance.
Proven track record of delivering complex technology initiatives within agreed timelines and quality expectations.
Strong technical understanding of enterprise application architecture, APIs, databases, cloud infrastructure and distributed systems.
Experience managing dependencies, risks, competing priorities, scope changes and stakeholder expectations.
Excellent written and verbal communication, analytical thinking, decision-making and problem-solving skills.
Ability to engage effectively with both senior business stakeholders and hands-on engineering teams.
Experience working with remote or geographically distributed teams.
Technical Knowledge

The candidate should have a strong working understanding of the following technologies and concepts:

Backend: Node.js, Python, Flask, and/or FastAPI.
Frontend: Angular or React, TypeScript, HTML and CSS.
Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS, Azure or equivalent cloud platforms.
Containers & Deployment: Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines and Linux environments.
Architecture: REST APIs, microservices, event-driven systems, multi-tenant SaaS and distributed applications.
Data & Storage: Relational databases, data modeling, caching, object storage and data integration patterns.
Engineering Practices: Version control, code review processes, automated testing, observability and production release management.
Note: This position requires technical fluency to guide and coordinate engineering delivery; expert hands-on proficiency in every technology is not mandatory.

Preferred Experience

Experience in Enterprise SaaS, FinTech, RegTech, ESG, Sustainability, Compliance or Financial Reporting platforms.
Experience delivering regulatory reporting, disclosure management, financial data processing or audit-focused software.
Familiarity with XBRL, iXBRL, regulatory taxonomies, validation workflows or structured reporting standards.
Experience managing multi-team programs involving complex integrations, large datasets and enterprise customer requirements.
Experience coordinating cloud migrations, platform modernization, system integrations or architecture transformations.
Familiarity with information security, data privacy, regulatory compliance and enterprise software delivery controls.
AI & LLM Experience

Experience managing or delivering AI-powered applications involving some of the following:

Large Language Models (LLMs), NLP and generative AI.
Prompt engineering and structured output generation.
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and retrieval pipelines.
LangChain and/or LlamaIndex.
Vector databases such as FAISS, ChromaDB or Pinecone.
Embeddings, semantic search and document intelligence.
AI model evaluation, accuracy measurement and quality assurance.
Integration with managed AI services and model providers.
AI security, privacy, governance and responsible deployment practices.
Tools & Delivery Practices

Experience with program and project management tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps or equivalent platforms.
Proficiency in maintaining roadmaps, delivery plans, RAID logs, dependency trackers and executive status reports.
Experience with Agile planning, sprint reviews, retrospectives, release coordination and cross-functional governance.
Ability to define measurable outcomes and use delivery metrics to improve execution predictability

Key Skills: Project,Engineering management,Software,Technical management,Software engineering,Engineering,Program,Delivery

title: Project Engineer
description:
Job Description Project Engineer Our current projects are engineering-led landscaping projects with steel framing, anchoring, access and MEP coordination 
 Location: Mumbai | Experience: 6 years | Department: Projects | Employment: Full Time, Permanent 
 About Vertvista Vertvista Eco Solutions Pvt. Ltd. is a biophilic design and commercial landscaping company operating across Mumbai, Pune, Bengaluru, Chennai, Hyderabad and Gujarat. We design, engineer and install green walls, green facades, planter systems, FRP planters and irrigation infrastructure for corporate offices, developers and institutional campuses. 
 Role Purpose Own the end-to-end execution of assigned projects from drawing and BOQ handover through fabrication, installation, testing, handover and final billing — delivered on time, within budget and to specification. This is an engineering and execution role. Plant selection, plant health and all horticulture inputs are handled by Vertvista’s in-house agriculture and horticulture team. 
 Key Responsibilities 1. Study drawings, BOQs and work orders; prepare material take-offs, measurement sheets and quantity reconciliation. 2. Plan and drive site execution — manpower deployment, daily progress, and sequencing with the main contractor, PMC and interior fit-out agencies. 3. Supervise fabrication and installation of MS/SS structures, anchoring and fixing systems, cable-net and trellis facade systems, FRP and metal planters, and green wall framing and panels. 4. Verify site dimensions before fabrication; coordinate shop drawings and mark-ups with the design team and consultant. 5. Coordinate procurement with the purchase team; inspect all incoming material against specification, dimension and quantity before acceptance. 6. Execute, test and commission irrigation and allied plumbing infrastructure — tanks, pumps, pipelines, drip lines, drainage, waterproofing and liners — and hand over automation controls in working condition. 7. Prepare and submit client documentation: method statements, ITP, HIRA, material approval requests, progress reports and site MoM. 8. Track project cost against budget; identify deviations, extra items and variations and raise them in time. 9. Prepare RA bills and the final bill with the QS team; close snag lists and complete handover documentation. 10. Update Zoho Projects daily with tasks, progress, photographs and issues. 11. Enforce site safety, EHS compliance and housekeeping as per client site requirements. 
 Requirements 6 years of site execution experience in interior fit-out, civil, facade, MEP or fabrication-led contracting. B.E. / B.Tech or Diploma in Civil or Mechanical Engineering. Ability to read and mark up AutoCAD drawings; strong Excel skills for BOQ, measurement and reconciliation. Practical knowledge of MS/SS fabrication, welding and anchoring details, waterproofing, and plumbing pipework. Proven ability to handle corporate clients, PMCs and general contractors independently. Strong billing, documentation and site record discipline. Based in Mumbai, willing to travel to sites daily and outstation when required. Good to Have Facade, glazing, cladding or structural steel installation experience. High-rise podium, terrace or rooftop project execution. Exposure to IGBC / LEED site documentation. MS Project, Primavera or Zoho Projects. 
 Location & Reporting Based at the Mumbai (Powai) office with daily site movement. Reports to the Project Manager / Director – Projects.

Key Skills: Project Engineering,Project Execution,Project Planning,Planning,Project,Execution,Engineering

title: Project Manager
description:
Project Manager
Department Project Management Office (PMO) / Delivery
Reports To Delivery Manager / Head of Delivery
Experience 3+ years in project management (services / consulting environment)
Location Remote (occasional travel for client or team offsites, if required)
Employment Type Full-time
Shift Aligned to client time zones flexibility for European / North
American overlap where required
ABOUT THE ROLE
Our Project Managers set the standard for how delivery runs they own the plan, run the
governance, protect the margin, and make sure the client sees measurable return on every rupee
they spend with us.
We are looking for a highly organised, proactive Project Manager who can independently run
4–5 concurrent client projects end to end. This is a hands-on delivery role: you will run the sprint
ceremonies, own the RAID log, chase the blocker, build the dashboard, and then present the
delivery story to a client stakeholder in the same day.
The person who succeeds here brings structure to ambiguity, communicates in facts rather than
adjectives, and escalates early with a proposed solution attached. Project Mobilisation & Onboarding
Take overall responsibility for planning, coordination, execution, and completion of new client
onboarding in line with the standard onboarding playbook — delivered within the agreed
timetable and budget.
Prepare and maintain the onboarding plan, project plan, milestone schedule, resource
plan, and RAID log (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies).
Run project kick-off and mobilise extended teams, including internal squads, consultants, and
third-party vendors.
Define project scope, objectives, deliverables, and — where applicable — technical
specifications, involving all relevant stakeholders and confirming technical feasibility before
commitment.
Establish clear entry/exit criteria, acceptance criteria, and a RACI matrix (Responsible,
Accountable, Consulted, Informed) so ownership is unambiguous from day one. Service Delivery & Day-to-Day Operations
Lead day-to-day delivery of contracted services across 4–5 accounts, ensuring quality,
productivity, and continuity across distributed teams.
Ensure every project is delivered on time, within scope, and within budget.
Coordinate internal resources and third-party vendors to ensure proper execution.
Manage the testing and acceptance regime — including phased and final acceptance — and
align milestone sign-offs to the agreed performance-based payment plan.
Manage ticket queues and support operations: incident and request management, triage,
prioritisation, SLA tracking, and closure.
Track project performance against short-term and long-term goals, and adjust constraints based
on financial and delivery analysis. Daily & Weekly Milestone Targets
Break every project plan down into daily and weekly milestones with named owners, due
dates, and a clear definition of "done" — no task carried without a date against it.
Set and communicate daily delivery targets for each squad at stand-up; confirm at end of day
what moved, what slipped, and what is at risk for tomorrow.
Own weekly milestone achievement across all 4–5 projects: track planned vs. actual
completion, calculate slippage, and publish a weekly milestone scorecard to Delivery leadership.
Maintain a target of 90% weekly milestone adherence per project; any milestone missed
must carry a documented reason, recovery plan, and revised date within 24 hours.
Run a short daily blocker review — anything blocking a daily target for more than one working
day is escalated the same day, not held to the weekly review.
Reconcile daily task closure and weekly milestone burn against sprint burndown so the sprint,
the plan, and the client commitment never drift apart.
Chase timesheet and effort logging daily so weekly effort-vs-plan variance is accurate before it
reaches Finance or the client.
Publish a weekly delivery summary every Friday per account: milestones achieved,
milestones missed with cause, upcoming week's targets, open risks, and open blockers.
Convert weekly misses into corrective action in the next planning cycle — repeated slippage on
the same workstream is treated as a structural problem, not a scheduling one. Agile & Scrum Execution
Run all Scrum ceremonies: sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and
backlog refinement.
Own and groom the product/project backlog alongside the Product Owner and client
stakeholders.
Break epics into user stories with clear acceptance criteria; ensure stories are estimated and
sprint-ready before planning.
Track and act on velocity, burndown/burnup, cycle time, throughput, and defect trends
— forecast from data, not optimism.
Apply the right framework per engagement: Scrum, Kanban, Scrumban, Waterfall, or a hybrid
model, as the contract and client maturity demand.
Continuously improve workflow efficiency; ensure retrospective actions are actually
implemented, not just recorded. Tooling, Dashboards & Reporting
Configure and administer Azure DevOps and Jira — boards, workflows, custom fields, epics/
features/stories, sprints, iterations, and release plans.
Build and maintain dashboards for sprint progress, delivery health, defect trends, SLA
adherence, resource utilisation, and risk exposure — for both team-level and executive
audiences.
Produce weekly status reports (WSR), MIS reports for senior management to support
strategic decisions, governance decks, and monthly delivery reviews.
Create and maintain comprehensive project documentation, communication plans, and a live
decision/action log.
Working knowledge expected across: Confluence, ServiceNow, MS Project, MS Visio, Excel
(advanced formulas, pivot tables, dashboards), PowerPoint, and BI/reporting tools such
as Power BI.
Stay current on new Excel, PowerPoint, and AI-assisted productivity tooling to keep reporting
sharp and effort low. Governance, Reporting & Stakeholder Management
Operate the engagement governance model: chair operational performance meetings, support
periodic governance committee reviews, and contribute to annual strategic reviews.
Prepare meeting agendas, presentations, and minutes within agreed timelines.
Manage escalations through defined governance tiers — with a documented owner, action,
and target date for every open item.
Act as the primary day-to-day point of contact for client stakeholders on assigned accounts.
Present oral and written reports covering plans, problems, and resolutions to the appropriate
level of management.
Manage expectations proactively: flag anything that may affect timely completion the moment it
is known, never at the review. Risk, Change & Blocker Management
Proactively identify, document, and communicate risks, and propose mitigation approaches
before they become issues.
Identify roadblocks early — scope creep, technical dependencies, resource constraints, thirdparty
delays — and drive them to resolution.
Run a disciplined blocker/impediment process: log it, assign it, escalate it, close it within
agreed timelines.
Manage all changes to scope, schedule, and cost through a formal change-control process —
impact assessment, client approval, re-baselining.
Convert genuine scope expansion into commercial opportunity rather than absorbing it silently. Commercial & Resource Management
Manage project budget and resource allocation; monitor costs and track expenses to protect
delivery margin.
Support Work Orders, SOWs, and Change Requests — including scope, volumes, charges,
and applicable service levels.
Communicate resource requirements and availability ahead of need, not at the point of crisis.
Track and follow up on client invoices and receivables in coordination with Finance.
Ensure sufficient, competent staffing and team continuity across extended teams and
consultants. Quality, Security & Compliance
Ensure final deliverables meet both the agreed brief and the technical requirements.
Ensure delivery complies with contractual security requirements, data processing obligations,
supplier code of conduct, and applicable legal and regulatory requirements.
Maintain audit-ready project documentation at all times. People & Continuous Improvement
Mentor team members on Agile practice, delivery hygiene, and stakeholder communication.
Support team building, resourcing, and retention within a distributed working model.
Continuously identify ways to improve quality, efficiency, and competitiveness of delivery in line
with engagement improvement commitments.
EXPERTISE YOU'LL BRING
Must-Have
3+ years of project management experience, ideally in an IT services, consulting, digital
agency, or managed-services environment.
Demonstrated ability to manage 4–5 concurrent projects without letting delivery quality slip
on any of them.
Hands-on proficiency with Azure DevOps and Jira — configuration and reporting, not just
usage.
Strong practical command of Agile and Scrum, backlog management, sprint execution, and
ceremony facilitation.
Working knowledge of RACI, RAID logs, change control, and structured escalation/
blocker mechanisms.
Proven discipline in setting and tracking daily and weekly milestone targets, with visible
planned-vs-actual reporting.
Familiarity with ticketing systems and incident/request management (ServiceNow or
equivalent) and time/resource management tooling.
Strong MS Office skills — Excel (formulas, pivot tables, dashboards) and PowerPoint at a clientpresentable
standard.
Excellent written and spoken English; structured, data-driven communication.
Strong attention to detail, organisational discipline, and the ability to prioritise across competing
deadlines.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT, Project Management, Business, or a
related discipline (Master's/MBA desirable).
Proven self-management in a remote setting — reliable connectivity, a professional working
environment, and strong async communication habits.
Certification (at least one required)
Certified ScrumMaster (CSM) or Professional Scrum Master (PSM I / II)
PMP, CAPM, PMI-ACP, or PRINCE2 / PRINCE2 Agile
SAFe Agilist / SAFe Scrum Master
ITIL Foundation (advantage for support and managed-services engagements)
Microsoft Certified: Azure DevOps Engineer (advantage)
Good-to-Have
Exposure to SLA/KPI-based engagements and commercial constructs (SOWs, Work Orders,
Change Requests).
Experience with onshore–offshore or distributed delivery models serving European or North
American clients.
Basic understanding of databases/queries, SDLC, UI/UX principles, CMS platforms, and QA/
production environments.
Familiarity with creative delivery workflows (design, content, video) where engagements are
agency-adjacent.
Exposure to regulated environments (BFSI, healthcare, public sector) or government/publicsector
project delivery.
Commercial acumen: budgeting, forecasting, margin management, and contract awareness.
QUALITIES & CHARACTERISTICS
Ownership: a strong sense of personal responsibility for your own and the team's work — you
proactively step in to ensure quality delivery within timeframes, whatever the situation.
Composure: able to lead cross-functional teams and stay calm under tight deadlines and client
pressure.
Negotiation: comfortable holding a position with a client while keeping the relationship intact.
Curiosity: eager to learn new tools, frameworks, and techniques in project management and
delivery.
Judgement: knows what to escalate, what to absorb, and what to decide alone.
KEY SUCCESS FACTORS IN THIS ROLE
Managing multiple projects and priorities across regions and time zones simultaneously.
Balancing global delivery standards with individual client expectations.
Maintaining accuracy and predictability of forecasts while running at high volume.
Building trust with clients you will rarely, if ever, meet in person.
SUCCESS INDICATORS — FIRST 6 MONTHS
All assigned projects delivered within agreed schedule, effort, and margin variance thresholds.
90% weekly milestone adherence sustained across all assigned projects, with every miss
carrying a documented cause and recovery plan.
Daily targets and weekly scorecards published consistently without prompting from leadership.
Live, accurate dashboards available to leadership and clients without manual chasing.
Zero surprises — risks and blockers surfaced before they become escalations.
Measurable improvement in sprint predictability and velocity stability.
Clean, audit-ready documentation and a fully current RAID log across every account.
WHAT WE OFFER
100% remote working with a distributed, delivery-focused team.
Exposure to diverse clients, domains, and technology stacks — broader in a year than most
product roles give in three.
Certification sponsorship and structured learning support.
Real ownership from day one — you run your accounts, not someone else's checklist.
Note: Adjust tool names and certification preferences to match your actual delivery stack before
publishing.

Key Skills: Agile/Scrum,Project Management,Azure DevOps,Sprint Planning & Execution,Scrum,Sprint Review,JIRA,IT Project Management
